text: Tom Pl I have seen people who work as part of a flight crew succeed. For everyone else, nope. They will basically say that this was a key requirement for the visa and that you obviously should not have taken a job that moves your center of life abroad. Don't expect any leniency from them if you breach the 3-months. They will very likely respond by slowing down your case, giving you shorter visas, and indicate that your case is in trouble if you don't change your travel pattern.
